en:
Nyeh, what?
You want to talk to me, too?
Angie's been talking to me non-stop...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Himiko for a while?

Nyeeeh...
Are you that interested in my magic?

Well, if you're really that interested, 
I guess I can tell you a little bit about it...

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko spent some time teaching me
about her tricks— Ah! "Magic"...
<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko and I grew a little closer today.
